verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a professional legal-services firm offering attorney-managed immigration and startup legal packages, not a software product with a UI whose functions could be mirrored by an API. API/UI parity is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an API: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and an llms.txt file is not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
